scripts.setup: npm run docker:up && npm run db:setup && npm run dev
scripts.db:setup: docker compose exec -T app-postgres psql -U app_user -d database_knowledge_assistant < apps/backend/schema.sql && npm run seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/backend && npm run typecheck -w apps/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/backend && npm run build -w apps/frontend
